standard_prerequisites.name: Almost GC structure as a complex Dirac structure
standard_prerequisites.statement: A maximally isotropic linear subbundle of the generalized tangent bundle T M is a Dirac structure and a maximally isotropic linear subbundle of its complexification is a complex Dirac structure; an almost GC structure on M is a complex Dirac structure E with E intersected with its conjugate equal to zero, and the same object may be written as a bundle map J on the generalized tangent bundle; the article's own formulation is retained at source lines 138-141.
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the object supplied by the hypothesis of the counted proposition, namely the almost GC structure J on M, and the bundle map J that the proof averages against.

standard_prerequisites.name: Splitting bundle and split submanifold
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a submanifold S of an almost GC manifold (M,J), a splitting bundle is a subbundle N of the restricted generalized tangent bundle over S with T M restricted to S equal to T S plus N, such that T S plus the annihilator of N inside the generalized tangent bundle is invariant under J; a submanifold admitting such a bundle is a split submanifold of (M,J); retained at source lines 312-314.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is exactly the conclusion of the counted proposition: the proof constructs such an N by averaging over the compact group and then verifies the required J-invariance.

standard_prerequisites.name: Canonical action of a Lie group on an almost GC manifold
standard_prerequisites.statement: A smooth action of a Lie group G on a manifold M lifts to an action on the generalized tangent bundle by the bundle automorphisms (g_*,(g^{-1})^*); the action on an H-twisted GC manifold is canonical when H is G-invariant and the action on the generalized tangent bundle commutes with J, that is the corresponding diagram commutes for every g in G; retained at source lines 336-359.
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the second hypothesis of the counted proposition and the commutation J composed with the group action that the proof uses to keep the fixed-point data invariant.

core_obligations: Fix a component S of the fixed point set M^G of a canonical action of a compact Lie group G on an almost GC manifold (M,J) (source line 388).

Use that for x in S the derivative of the action defines a linear action of G on T_x M with T_x S equal to the fixed space (T_x M)^G, and average over G using a bi-invariant Haar measure normalised to total mass one, obtaining a bundle map pi from T M restricted to S onto T S by pi_x(v) = the integral over G of g·v (source lines 389-394).

Define the subbundle N of the restricted tangent bundle by N_x = ker pi_x, note that pi is a bundle map and N a vector bundle by naturality of averaging, and record the direct sum decomposition T_x M = (T_x M)^G plus N_x = T_x S plus N_x (source line 395).

Reduce the conclusion to the claim that the annihilator of W = N_x equals the fixed space (V^*)^G of the dual, because then the fixed part of V plus V^* equals V^G plus the annihilator of W, and J, commuting with the action, preserves that subspace (source lines 396-397).

Prove the claim: for lambda annihilating W and u = v + w with v fixed and w in W, compute (g·lambda)(u) through the displayed alignat chain to see it equals lambda(u), so that lambda is fixed by G and the annihilator of W lies in (V^*)^G (source lines 399-423).

Compare dimensions: the annihilator of W is isomorphic to the dual of V/W, which is isomorphic to the dual of V^G, so the dimensions agree and the annihilator of W equals (V^*)^G, completing the proof that S is a split submanifold (source lines 423-433).

proof_roadmap.step: Take a component S of the fixed point set and identify its tangent space at x with the fixed subspace of T_x M.
Average the action over the compact group with a normalised Haar measure to get a projection pi, set N equal to its kernel and record the splitting.
Reduce the required J-invariance to the identity between the annihilator of N and the fixed dual space.
Verify by the alignat computation that any lambda annihilating N is fixed by the group.
Conclude by dimension count that the inclusion is an equality, hence S is split.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 SIGMA 6 (2010) 081 的 Proposition prop9（源 382-384 行，证明 387-434 行，共 48 行）：设紧 Lie 群 G 以 canonical 方式作用在 almost GC 流形 (M,J) 上，证明不动点集 M^G 的每个连通分支都是 (M,J) 的 split 子流形。关键操作不是例行核验：作者必须先用双不变 Haar 测度对 G 的线性作用做平均，造出丛映射 pi 并令 N=ker pi，再利用平均的自然性看出 N 是向量丛、得到分解 T_x M=(T_x M)^G⊕N_x（389-395 行）；随后把「J 保持 T S⊕Ann(N)」这一目标化归为「Ann(N) 等于对偶的固定子空间 (V^*)^G」（396-397 行），这一步的等价性依赖于 J 与作用交换；最后用 alignat 链式展开逐项计算 (g·λ)(u)=λ(u) 证明 λ 被 G 固定（399-423 行），再用 Ann(W)≅(V/W)^*≅(V^G)^* 的维数比较把包含升级为相等（423-433 行）。难点在于「用积分平均把作用投影到不动子空间」与「对偶侧的固定子空间恰为消失子」这两个方向的转化；原文位置在证明的 389-397 行与 399-433 行。
